_doc: agent-harness#1135 caller table: every direct src/ call of a BAML-reaching function, keyed to the plan's caller-table row. test_phase_loop_baml_v1_callers.py fails on any unlisted call site, so the table cannot silently go stale. Keys are file::enclosing-function::callee.

rows.closeout-parse: runner._parse_native_closeout_status -> discovery.parse_closeout_payload_doc: BamlWorkerError maps to a not-evaluated unretryable_external_outage blocker; never contract_bug.
rows.tier3: evidence_audit.run_tier3_runner_audit -> evaluate_suspected_fake_evidence: BamlWorkerError blocks the closeout as 'Tier 3 NOT run' (unretryable_external_outage); never uncertain, never skipped.
rows.tier3-cli: evidence_audit.run_evidence_audit (the forensic evidence-audit CLI with --enable-tier3): BamlWorkerError propagates typed; no verdict is written.
rows.launch-wave: run_loop._prepare_phase_launch -> build_prompt inside the concurrent wave: propagates before run_phase_worker_pool; the finally reclaims only unlaunched worktrees.
rows.delegated: run_loop._finalize_phase_launch -> launch_delegated_child: pre-launch BamlWorkerError / BamlValidationError route into the branch's blocked flow; the parent result is always persisted.
rows.delegated-child: launch_delegated_child's own build_prompt (pre-launch, handled by the delegated row) and its child's _parsed_child_automation (post-launch, recorded on the child).
rows.finalize: _parsed_child_automation callers: the closeout-parse row handles every BamlWorkerError inside _parse_native_closeout_status; nothing propagates.
rows.prompt-chain: prompt helpers that only forward to the rows above (build_prompt -> build_prompt_bundle -> injection._render_baml_closeout_instruction -> build_baml_request); no handler of their own (#22).
rows.discovery-chain: discovery helpers that only forward to the closeout-parse row.
rows.evidence-chain: evaluate_suspected_fake_evidence's own calls: BamlWorkerError is re-raised before its content-error handler.
rows.class-name: parse_baml_response with a CLASS name: the regex-only branch; never reaches the worker.
